title: The Pink Perfume Gift Guide for Her
description: A pink perfume gift guide for her from Sam's Club: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy, Versace Bright Crystal, Lancome La Vie Est Belle, Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl, Ralph Lauren Romance and a Gucci travel miniature set.
intro: Perfume is the gift I always say is too boring and then secretly hope someone gets me. It is the one present that sits on the dresser all year and makes you feel put together on the days you absolutely are not. So I rounded up the pink ones, plus one red stiletto because I could not leave it out. A big glass bottle with a bow, a crystal-cap classic, a heel you will want to display like art, and a little set of minis for the friend who can never pick just one.

sections.heading: The pink bottles
paragraphs: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum 3.4 fl oz, Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette 3 fl oz and the Gucci Travel Miniature Eau de Parfum 4-piece set.

sections.heading: The showstoppers
paragraphs: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum, Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum 1.7 fl oz and Ralph Lauren Romance Eau de Parfum 3.4 fl oz.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The dresser, the mirror and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, size and set contents before you buy.
